propositions: A concurrent commit landing between verify and sign steps reads different HEAD revisions, causing verification to pass on SHA-A but signing to refuse SHA-B, yet the ticket closes without a completion attestation
The close transition proceeds regardless of sign refusal, leaving the ticket permanently closed and unsigned with no non-force recovery path
The default (no --ref) code path reads HEAD independently in verify and sign steps, creating a TOCTOU window, while the --ref path does not suffer this split
The suggested recovery ('re-close to certify') fails because the ticket is already closed and cannot be re-closed from closed state
Either pinning a single revision for the entire verify-sign-close unit or aborting the close on drift (leaving the ticket retryable in in_progress) would prevent unsigned-close outcomes
